reason: Storage dispatch scan past old history (#1093). The dispatch loop and the Storage page now select open rows (pending dispatches, unresolved incidents, unfinished actions) through new partial indexes before limiting, page by (created_at, id), and keep the newest history on the page; a project worker reads only its own sources' dispatches. Migration 0051_storage_open_rows adds three partial indexes only. test_storage_open_rows covers the paged scan, project isolation, index use in the query plan, and upgrade/downgrade of 0051 on rows saved before it; test_storage_integrations covers a pending dispatch after 2000 settled ones and the dashboard keeping new and open records; test_runtime_bundle reviews the new migration head. One test_runtime_coordination case is selected so CI provisions PostgreSQL and the storage tests run on both SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, native, provider, harness or API-worker change. Playwright storage-integrations area excluded: the scan has no UI change and real-core.spec.ts is not run on main; a scratch supervisor Core and a cross-version PostgreSQL probe (7495a04 code writing on a 0051 database) were run locally instead. All unrelated tests excluded.
